title: Re-find the overlooked nuclear transients of the ZTF archive
question: With alert photometry and a fixed six-criterion screen, how much of the alert stream would a person have to look at to re-find the nuclear transients that Quintin et al. (2026) reported as overlooked?
ground_truth_source: Quintin et al., Lost and Found: a gallery of overlooked optical nuclear transients from the ZTF archive, A&A 710, A247 (2026), arXiv:2511.19016, table 1, CC BY 4.0
